description: The Committee on Education and Labor, Majority is currently seeking undergraduate and graduate interns and fellows for spring of 2020. Specifically we are seeking general undergraduate interns, graduate and legal interns and fellows for the labor policy team, graduate and legal interns and fellows for the health policy team and graduate and legal interns and fellows for the oversight team. Interns perform a variety of tasks that support the staff in our legislative and media work. The Committee on Education and Labor is a legislative office within the U.S. House of Representatives. The Committee has jurisdiction over a broad array of child welfare, education and labor policy areas, including early childhood education, K-12 education, higher education, employer/employee relations, worker safety, and employer provided health care. Representative Robert C. "Bobby" Scott (D-VA) serves as Chairman.
responsibilities: Technical writing including legislation, memos, and speeches
Assisting staff in hearing and markup preparation and execution
Attending other hearings, markups, briefings and meetings to inform staff and Members as they work to craft legislation and policy proposals
Helping to organize and staff Committee press conferences
Assisting with the production of daily news clips
qualifications: Undergraduate or graduate student status

Fellows must be participating in an established fellowship program
